text.p: Favourites Bosnia handed Slovenia their third successive World Cup qualifying defeat when they scored a 2-1 victory in group one on Sunday.
(Corrects to clarify Slovenia have lost three, not four, world cup matches)
The loss, which left Slovenia with no chance of reaching the World Cup finals, came in the first meeting of the two ex-Yugoslav republics' teams since Slovenia gained independence in 1991.
It was Bosnia's second victory against two defeats in the group.

Bosnia set the early pace and striker Elvir Bolic opened the scoring in the fifth minute when he ploughed through Slovenia's weak defence and fired in a high shot over goalkeeper Bosko Boskovic's head.
Bosnian goalkeeper Mirsad Dedic denied Slovenia an equaliser in the 26th minute when he safely caught a thundering 20-metre free kick from forward Alfred Jermanis.
Instead, Meho Kodro made it 2-0 when he dribbled past three Slovenian defenders and the goalkeeper to net from close range in the 32nd minute.
The Slovenians were awarded a penalty after goalkeeper Dedic fouled forward Saso Udovic. It was converted by midfielder Zlatko Zahovic in the 41st minute.
Although Slovenia stepped up a gear after the break, they were still unable to pierce Bosnia's tight defence.

Slovenia: 1-Bosko Boskovic, 2-Robert Englaro, 3-Darko Milanic, 4-Ales Krizan, 5-Alfred Jermanis, 6-Dzoni Novak, 7-Ales Ceh, 8-Zlatko Zahovic, 9-Amir Karic (Peter Binkovski 78), 10-Saso Udovic, 11-Ante Simundza (Ivica Vulic 45).

Bosnia: 1-Mirsad Dedic, 2-Nermin Sabic (Sead Kapetanovic 89), 3-Bakir Besirevic, 4-Muhamed Konjic, 5-Senad Begic, 6-Murat Jasarevic, 7-Vlatko Glavas , 8-Sead Halilovic, 9-Hasan Salihamidzic, 10-Meho Kodro, 11-Elvir Bolic (Senad Brkic 87).
